fields.Name: T251 - Tags Taxonomy Tree Navigation
fields.Description: Exercises the custom taxonomy tree + master/detail governance panel (SelectTaxNode), a bespoke hierarchical UI distinct from generic grids and other left-nav sections.

InputDefinition.goal: Switch to the Knowledge Hub app via the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, then click 'Tags' in the left nav (fa-sitemap icon). On the Tags screen, ensure the 'Taxonomy' section is active and the 'Tree' sub-tab is selected, then click a tag node in the tree on the left. Success is that selecting a tree node populates the details panel on the right with that tag's stats (Items Tagged, Avg Weight, Children, Depth) and its action toolbar (Add Child / Rename / Move / Merge Into). If the taxonomy is empty, seeing the tree panel render with an empty-state and the 'Add root tag' (+) control is also success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Tags screen loads and the Taxonomy Tree view shows a tree panel plus a details/empty panel
Clicking a tree node populates the right details panel with tag stats and an action toolbar, OR an empty taxonomy shows the tree + 'Add root tag' control
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
